name: Data Preview Engine Room

business_logic: 1. Route-driven mode via watch() on the :id param (immediate: true) — param kosong → loadList(), param terisi → loadDetail(id)
2. loadList(): SELECT seluruh engine_room_record milik current user, apapun statusnya, ORDER BY updated_at DESC; set dateFilter default ke tanggal lokal hari ini, searchFilter kosong
3. filteredRecords computed: filter by dateFilter (bandingkan item.date.slice(0,10)) DAN searchFilter (substring case-insensitive terhadap engine_room_id)

4. On tap list item → jika status draft_ongoing/draft_paused: navigasi ke Form Engine Room dengan id item; jika saved/synced: navigasi ke route ini sendiri dengan :id param diisi (transisi ke mode detail)
5. loadDetail(id): getDraftWithDetails(id) — SELECT header + seluruh engine_room_detail rows (berapapun jumlahnya, termasuk nol), tanpa hitung ulang; not found → detailNotFound=true
6. Render mode detail: seluruh field header read-only + grid Engine Room Detail (26 kolom bacaan per baris) langsung dari data tersimpan
7. On 'Reset Filter' (mode list, saat hasil kosong) → kosongkan dateFilter dan searchFilter
8. On 'Back' → mode detail: navigasi ke mode list (route sama, tanpa :id); mode list: navigasi ke Monitor Engine Room

data_operations.description: SELECT seluruh record milik user (mode list), atau 1 record by id (mode detail)
SELECT seluruh baris milik record yang dibuka di mode detail (berapapun jumlahnya)

Checked By/Acknowledged By ditampilkan apa adanya tanpa pembatasan role

unit_test_cases.description: loads and filters records by today's date by default
unit_test_cases.given: engineRoomRecordRepo.getAllRecords(userId) returns records with mixed dates including today
unit_test_cases.expect: filteredRecords initially only includes records dated today

unit_test_cases.description: filters records by case-insensitive engine_room_id substring search
unit_test_cases.expect: both records match; searchFilter is case-insensitive

unit_test_cases.description: navigates to Form Engine Room (not detail mode) when a draft/pause item is tapped
unit_test_cases.expect: router navigates to storage-tank-form-equivalent route 'engine-room-form' with the item's id; no transition into this screen's own detail mode

unit_test_cases.description: navigates into this screen's own detail mode when a saved/synced item is tapped
unit_test_cases.expect: router navigates to this screen's own route with :id set to the item's id

unit_test_cases.description: loads full detail including all engine_room_detail rows when a valid id param is present
unit_test_cases.given: getDraftWithDetails(id) returns a record with 5 engine_room_detail rows
unit_test_cases.expect: detailRecord and detailRows are populated with all 5 rows, canonical time-slot order

unit_test_cases.description: sets detailNotFound when the id does not match any local record
unit_test_cases.expect: detailNotFound=true; detail UI shows a not-found message with a working Back button

unit_test_cases.description: renders an empty detail grid without error when the record has zero engine_room_detail rows
unit_test_cases.given: getDraftWithDetails(id) returns a record with details=[]
unit_test_cases.expect: detailRows=[]; UI shows the empty-state message, not an error

screen_dependencies.reason: Entry point (Load Data) dan tujuan Back dari mode list
Tap item draft/pause di mode list membuka Form Engine Room

implementation_notes: Semua operasi lokal di SQLite via engineRoomRecordRepo.ts (getAllRecords, getDraftWithDetails), tidak ada panggilan API
Dual-mode via watch() pada route :id param (immediate: true), Vue Router reuse instance komponen ini untuk navigasi param-only pada route record yang sama
Stasiun ini TIDAK memiliki tabel referensi target operasional — tidak ada section untuk itu di mode detail
Date filter membandingkan item.date.slice(0,10) karena engine_room_record.date adalah datetime lokal penuh (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss)

Badge status list mode: draft_ongoing/draft_paused → 'Pause'; saved → 'Tersimpan'; synced → 'Tersinkron' (LIST_STATUS_BADGE_MAP); mode detail memakai mapping berbeda yang membedakan ongoing vs paused (DETAIL_STATUS_BADGE_MAP), mirrors DataPreviewStorageTankView.vue/DataPreviewEffluentPlantView.vue persis
